source: PRC Professional Regulatory Board of Nursing — Resolution No. 10, s. 2025 (Enhanced Tables of Specifications for the Nurses Licensure Examination)
note: The Enhanced TOS is competency-based and aligned with the Philippine Qualifications Framework (PQF) and Bloom's Taxonomy. It supersedes the 2006 and 2017 frameworks.

exam_parts.name: Nursing Practice I
exam_parts.description: Community Health Nursing — Care of individuals, families, population groups, and communities

exam_parts.name: Nursing Practice II
exam_parts.description: Care of Healthy/At-Risk Mother and Child — Maternal and child nursing, human growth and development

exam_parts.name: Nursing Practice III
exam_parts.description: Care of Clients with Physiologic and Psychosocial Alterations (Part A) — Surgery, oxygenation, fluids and electrolytes, infectious/inflammatory/immunologic response, cellular aberrations

exam_parts.name: Nursing Practice IV
exam_parts.description: Care of Clients with Physiologic and Psychosocial Alterations (Part B) — Metabolic, endocrine, gastrointestinal, renal, neurologic, sensory, and musculoskeletal alterations

exam_parts.name: Nursing Practice V
exam_parts.description: Care of Clients with Physiologic and Psychosocial Alterations (Part C) — Psychiatric/mental health nursing, care of older adults, and other specialty areas

integrated_knowledge_areas.note: These areas are integrated across all five Nursing Practice parts — not tested as separate subjects.
areas: Nursing Process (Assessment, Diagnosis, Planning, Implementation, Evaluation)

competency_standards.note: The NLE tests competencies across the 11 Key Areas of Responsibility from the Competency Standards of Nursing Practice in the Philippines.

blooms_taxonomy_distribution.note: The Enhanced TOS explicitly incorporates Bloom's Taxonomy cognitive domains. Exact percentages are defined per subject in the full TOS document.
